enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Move right arm. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Breathe in. Breathe out.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Pour hot water into cup. Add coffee powder. Stir coffee. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Stand up. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work clothes and packing bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Remove pajama top. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Remove pajama bottoms. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Place laptop in bag. Place phone in bag. Place keys in bag. Place wallet in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Exit bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Exit house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Scan transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Hold bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to health care facility. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workstation. Put on lab coat. Turn on computer. Log in. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Write notes. Attend meeting. Update records. Take phone call. Consult with colleague.

Go to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Stand up. Wash hands. Exit break room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient care and record keeping
enriched_activities.desc: Return to workstation. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Write notes. Attend meeting. Update records. Take phone call. Consult with colleague. Organize files.

Leave facility. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Scan transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, cleaning up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Dry dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Put down remote. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Continue browsing. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet leisure time on the phone, winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Open messaging app. Send message. Close phone. Stand up. Change into pajamas. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Check email. Close phone. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Move arm. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Breathe in. Breathe out.
